title.quote:
Probabilistic Mobility Load Balancing for
Multi-band 5G and Beyond Networks
title.justification: Title as given on the paper's first page.
title.value: Probabilistic Mobility Load Balancing for Multi-band 5G and Beyond Networks

extractions.description: The paper formulates multi-band mobility load balancing (MLB) in 5G cellular networks as a multi-objective stochastic UE-band assignment problem, transforms it into a Linear Program via the epigraph technique, and proposes an event-triggered algorithm (PMLB) with probabilistic rounding. It is evaluated in a proprietary packet-level System Level Simulator against rule-based and 3GPP-defined MLB baselines.

type.quote: The experiments are conducted on a proprietary System Level Simulator (SLS) [10], which is a packet-level simulator that emulates traffic for 5G networks based on real-word data.
type.justification: The paper proposes an algorithm and evaluates it via simulation experiments, though it also includes optimization formulation/transformation.
